title: Installing Clay Plugin (API & CLI)
snippet:
You'll need:
- **A paid coding agent plan:** Claude (Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise) for Claude Code, or ChatGPT (Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, or Enterprise) for Codex. If your company manages Claude, check that Claude Code is enabled for you.
- **Editor or Admin access** in the Clay workspace you'll connect.
- **On Windows, admin rights** (or help from IT) for one step.

| Plan | Results per request | Results per search | Results per period |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free** | 50 | 50 | 100 per 30 days |
| **Trial** | 50 | 50 | 10,000 per 14 days |
| **Flex** | 500 | Up to your period limit | 50,000 per 30 days |
| **Paid self-serve plans** | 500 | Up to your period limit | 1,000,000 per 30 days |
| **Legacy paid plans** | 500 | Up to your period limit | 1,000,000 per year |
| **Enterprise** | 500 | Up to your period limit | 10,000,000 per 30 days |

title: Announcing the Clay Partner Program – A new ecosystem dedicated to empowering our partners - The GTM with Clay Blog
snippet:
It keeps essential resources within reach and grows more sophisticated as your expertise develops. The ecosystem is made up of two initiatives: the Solutions Partner Program and the Integrations Partner Program.
### **Solutions Partner Program**
The Solutions Partner Program is built for **go-to-market engineers, consultancies, and agencies** shaping the next wave of automation-first GTM.
Formerly known as our Experts and Enterprise Partners programs, this revamped track introduces new tiers, clearer benefits, and more visibility for the partners building cutting-edge workflows on Clay. Whether you’re helping clients streamline prospecting, orchestrate data enrichment, or plug Clay into a GTM system of record, this program is designed to support and scale your impact.

### **🔌 Integrations Partner Program**
The **Clay Integrations Partner Program** is designed for the data providers, platforms, and APIs powering the workflows our customers run every day.
As our ecosystem grows, we want to invest in the partners behind the scenes — giving them structure, resources, and visibility as they scale alongside Clay. This program is ideal for companies who want to **increase their API consumption, drive net-new users, and tap into the GTME movement**.

title: Integrations Partners | Clay.com
snippet:
- Partners receive a listing on our website and support docs, data consumption insights, priority support, and co-marketing opportunities once the integration is live.
- Partners are introduced to Clay's certified network of solutions partners and GTM engineers who actively build client workflows using integrated data.
- Unlock higher data consumption from your existing customer base as Clay's API-first, workflow-native environment drives deeper and more frequent usage.
